/help.question: How is my personal data protected?
/help.answer: Phone and passport numbers are encrypted and only shown masked to staff who need them. We keep data only as long as the retention rules in our privacy notice allow.

/help.question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
/help.answer: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your email. If an account exists, we send a link to set a new password.

/help.question: How do I download a copy of my data?
/help.answer: Sign in, open My account and choose Download my data. You get a file with the personal data we hold about your account. To correct or delete data, contact us; see the privacy notice for your rights.

/help.question: How do I book a tour?
/help.answer: Open a tour, choose a date under Dates & prices and press Book. Your seats are held for 15 minutes while you enter traveler details. Our team reviews the booking and confirms it, usually within one working day.

/help.question: Why is my tour booking "Pending"?
/help.answer: Every tour booking is checked by our operations team before it is confirmed, so we can make sure hotels, coaches and guides are ready. You will see the status change to Confirmed in My bookings.

/help.question: Are hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings confirmed straight away?
/help.answer: Yes. These bookings are confirmed instantly when you complete them, because the room or seat is reserved for you at that moment.

/help.question: How do I cancel a booking?
/help.answer: Go to My bookings, open the booking and choose Cancel. Hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the start date. Tour cancellations are reviewed by our team.

/help.question: How long do refunds take?
/help.answer: Approved refunds are sent back to the original payment method. Banks usually show them within 5 to 10 working days.

/help.question: What happens if a typhoon affects my trip?
/help.answer: If weather or transport problems affect a departure, our team contacts you with options: a new date, a changed itinerary or a refund.

/help.question: Is my deposit refunded if I cancel?
/help.answer: Hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings cancelled at least 24 hours before the start are refunded in full, deposit included. Tour cancellations follow the rules shown when you booked and are reviewed by our team.

/help.question: How do I use a coupon code?
/help.answer: Enter the code in the Coupon field when you book. The discount is checked and shown before you confirm. Each code has its own dates, minimum amount and usage limit.

/help.question: Why was my coupon not accepted?
/help.answer: A code may have expired, may not apply to that type of booking, may need a higher order total, or may already have been used the maximum number of times.

/help.question: Do I need to type the coupon code at checkout?
/help.answer: Not if you chose it on the Deals page. Press Use now and we remember the code; it is filled in and applied at checkout automatically when it fits what you are booking. You can still type or change a code yourself.

/help.question: Can I choose my taxi pickup time?
/help.answer: Yes. Airport and city transfers are booked for the time and address you enter. Your driver waits up to 60 minutes after a flight lands.

/help.question: How much luggage can I bring on domestic flights?
/help.answer: Each passenger may bring one carry-on bag. Checked baggage allowances are shown on each flight result.

/help.question: When do I pay?
/help.answer: Tour bookings can be paid once our team confirms them; hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings can be paid straight after booking. Open My bookings and choose Pay in full, or Pay a deposit to pay part now and the rest later.

/help.question: Which currency are prices in?
/help.answer: All prices are in New Taiwan dollars (TWD) and include tax unless stated otherwise.

/help.question: Can I pay a deposit and the rest later?
/help.answer: Yes. When your trip is more than 14 days away you can pay a 30% deposit now and the balance later. The balance due date is shown in My bookings, and you can pay it there at any time before then. Closer to the travel date, the full amount is due.

/help.question: Which payment methods can I use?
/help.answer: Payments go through our secure payment provider, where you can pay by credit card and, where offered, ATM transfer or convenience-store payment. We never see or store your card number.

/help.question: I paid but my booking still shows unpaid. What should I do?
/help.answer: Some methods, such as ATM transfers, take a little time to confirm. Refresh My bookings after a few minutes. If it still shows unpaid after one working day, contact us with your booking reference and we will check with the payment provider.

/public/content.subject: Cookie policy
/public/content.body:
We use only the cookies needed to keep you signed in safely. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies, so there is nothing to opt out of.
- Two essential cookies, both set by us.
- No advertising, analytics or social media trackers.
- Deleting cookies simply signs you out.

## What cookies are
Cookies are small text files a website stores in your browser. They let the site remember things between pages, such as that you are signed in.

## Cookies we use
### Sign-in cookie
- Purpose: keeps you signed in by renewing your session securely.
- Type: essential, set by {brand}.
- Protection: HttpOnly (scripts cannot read it), Secure (sent only over HTTPS) and SameSite=Strict (never sent by other websites).
- Lifetime: until you sign out, or about two weeks of inactivity.
### Request-protection cookie
- Purpose: proves that requests to change your account really come from this site, which stops other websites from acting on your behalf.
- Type: essential, set by {brand}.
- Lifetime: the same as your sign-in.

## Other storage
Your browser may keep small, harmless preferences on your device, such as a filter you chose. They never leave your device and contain no personal data.

## Third parties
When you pay, you are taken to our payment provider's secure page. That page is run by the provider and follows its own cookie policy.

## Managing cookies
You can delete cookies in your browser settings at any time. Because ours are essential, blocking them means you cannot stay signed in.

## Contact
Questions about cookies: {support}.

/public/content.subject: Privacy notice
/public/content.body:
This notice explains what personal data {brand} collects, why, who we share it with, how long we keep it and the rights you have under Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).
- We only collect what we need to run your bookings and your account.
- Phone and passport numbers are encrypted, and staff see them masked.
- We never sell your data or use advertising trackers.
- You can see, correct, export or delete your data at any time.

## Who we are
{brand} is the data controller for the personal data described here. You can reach our privacy team at {support}. We answer privacy requests within 15 working days, as the PDPA requires.

## What we collect
### Account details
- Your name, email address and password. Passwords are stored only as a salted hash; nobody, including our staff, can read them.
- Your preferred language and when you last signed in.
### Booking details
- The lead traveler's name, mobile phone number and, where a tour requires it, passport or ID number.
- Travel dates, the tours, rooms, seats or rides you book, and any special requests you write.
### Payment details
- The amount, method and status of each payment. Card numbers are entered on our payment provider's secure page and never reach our systems.
### Technical data
- Security logs of sign-ins and important account changes, kept to protect your account and to investigate misuse.

## Why we use it
- To create and manage your account (performance of a contract).
- To make, change and support your bookings with our hotels, transport and guide partners (performance of a contract).
- To take payments and handle refunds (performance of a contract and legal obligation).
- To keep the service secure and prevent fraud (legitimate interest).
- To send our newsletter, only if you subscribe; every email has an unsubscribe link (consent).

## Who we share it with
We share only what each partner needs to deliver your service:
- Hotels, airlines, bus and taxi companies and local guides: the lead traveler's name, dates and number of travelers.
- Our payment provider (ECPay, Taiwan): the payment amount and order reference, to process your payment securely.
- Authorities, only when Taiwanese law requires it.
We do not sell personal data, and we do not share it for advertising.

## How long we keep it
- Traveler details on a booking (names, phone, passport, special requests): anonymised two years after the travel date.
- Messages from our travel partners' systems: deleted after 180 days.
- Security and audit records: kept for seven years to meet accounting and legal duties.
- Your account: until you ask us to delete it.

## How we protect it
- Phone and passport numbers are encrypted with AES-GCM and shown masked to staff; revealing them is permission-controlled and logged.
- All traffic uses HTTPS. Sign-in sessions use secure, HttpOnly cookies and short-lived access tokens.
- Staff can only see what their role allows, and every sensitive action is recorded in an audit log that cannot be edited.

## Your rights
Under the PDPA you can ask us to:
- Show you the personal data we hold about you.
- Give you a copy of it (use Download my data in My account).
- Add to or correct it.
- Stop collecting, processing or using it.
- Delete it.
Write to {support} from the email on your account. We reply within 15 working days. Some data may have to be kept longer where the law requires it; we will tell you if so.

## Children
Our services are for adults. A child's details may be included in a booking only by their parent or guardian.

## Changes to this notice
If we change how we use personal data, we will update this page and the date above, and tell account holders by email about important changes.

## Contact
Questions or concerns: {support}. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you may contact the competent authority in Taiwan.

/public/content.subject: Terms of use
/public/content.body:
These terms apply when you use the {brand} website and book with us. Please read them before you book.
- Tours are confirmed after our team reviews them; hotels, flights, buses and taxis are confirmed instantly.
- You can pay in full, or pay a deposit and the balance later.
- Free cancellation rules are shown on each option before you book.
- Prices are in New Taiwan dollars (TWD) and include tax.

## About these terms
By creating an account or making a booking you agree to these terms and to our privacy notice. If you book for other travelers, you confirm they agree too.

## Your account
- Give accurate details and keep your password private. You are responsible for bookings made with your account.
- We may suspend accounts used for fraud, abuse of coupons or attempts to break the service.

## Bookings
### Tours
- Your seats are held for a short time while you complete the booking. A tour booking is confirmed only when our team approves it; you will see the status change in My bookings.
### Hotels, flights, buses and taxis
- These bookings are confirmed instantly because the room, seat or car is reserved for you at that moment.
- Taxi transfers are booked for the pickup time and address you give; drivers wait for the free waiting time shown on the booking.

## Prices and payment
- Prices are shown in New Taiwan dollars (TWD) and include tax unless stated otherwise.
- You may pay in full, or where offered pay a deposit now and the balance by the due date shown in My bookings. If the balance is not paid in time we may cancel the booking under the cancellation rules.
- Payments are processed securely by our payment provider. We never see or store your card number.

## Coupon codes
- Each code has its own dates, minimum order, booking types and usage limits, shown when you apply it.
- One code per booking. Codes cannot be exchanged for cash. If a booking is cancelled or rejected, the code can be used again within its limits.

## Changes and cancellations
- Cancel from My bookings. Hotels, flights, buses and taxis can usually be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the start; the exact rule is shown on each option.
- Tour cancellations are reviewed by our team, and refunds follow the rules shown when you booked.
- Approved refunds go back to the original payment method; banks usually show them within 5 to 10 working days.

## When we change or cancel
If weather, safety or a partner problem affects your trip, we will contact you with options: another date, a changed plan or a full refund of the affected part.

## Travel documents and conduct
- Bring valid photo ID and any permits your trip needs. Follow the instructions of guides, drivers and staff for everyone's safety.

## Liability
We plan and deliver your services with reasonable care. We are not responsible for losses caused by events outside our reasonable control, such as typhoons, earthquakes or government action. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under Taiwan's Consumer Protection Act.

## Governing law
These terms are governed by the laws of Taiwan (Republic of China).

## Contact
Questions about these terms: {support}.

/help.question: How is my personal data protected?
/help.answer: Phone and passport numbers are encrypted and only shown masked to staff who need them. We keep data only as long as the retention rules in our privacy notice allow.

/help.question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
/help.answer: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your email. If an account exists, we send a link to set a new password.

/help.question: How do I download a copy of my data?
/help.answer: Sign in, open My account and choose Download my data. You get a file with the personal data we hold about your account. To correct or delete data, contact us; see the privacy notice for your rights.

/help.question: How do I book a tour?
/help.answer: Open a tour, choose a date under Dates & prices and press Book. Your seats are held for 15 minutes while you enter traveler details. Our team reviews the booking and confirms it, usually within one working day.

/help.question: Why is my tour booking "Pending"?
/help.answer: Every tour booking is checked by our operations team before it is confirmed, so we can make sure hotels, coaches and guides are ready. You will see the status change to Confirmed in My bookings.

/help.question: Are hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings confirmed straight away?
/help.answer: Yes. These bookings are confirmed instantly when you complete them, because the room or seat is reserved for you at that moment.

/help.question: How do I cancel a booking?
/help.answer: Go to My bookings, open the booking and choose Cancel. Hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the start date. Tour cancellations are reviewed by our team.

/help.question: How long do refunds take?
/help.answer: Approved refunds are sent back to the original payment method. Banks usually show them within 5 to 10 working days.

/help.question: What happens if a typhoon affects my trip?
/help.answer: If weather or transport problems affect a departure, our team contacts you with options: a new date, a changed itinerary or a refund.

/help.question: Is my deposit refunded if I cancel?
/help.answer: Hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings cancelled at least 24 hours before the start are refunded in full, deposit included. Tour cancellations follow the rules shown when you booked and are reviewed by our team.

/help.question: How do I use a coupon code?
/help.answer: Enter the code in the Coupon field when you book. The discount is checked and shown before you confirm. Each code has its own dates, minimum amount and usage limit.

/help.question: Why was my coupon not accepted?
/help.answer: A code may have expired, may not apply to that type of booking, may need a higher order total, or may already have been used the maximum number of times.

/help.question: Do I need to type the coupon code at checkout?
/help.answer: Not if you chose it on the Deals page. Press Use now and we remember the code; it is filled in and applied at checkout automatically when it fits what you are booking. You can still type or change a code yourself.

/help.question: Can I choose my taxi pickup time?
/help.answer: Yes. Airport and city transfers are booked for the time and address you enter. Your driver waits up to 60 minutes after a flight lands.

/help.question: How much luggage can I bring on domestic flights?
/help.answer: Each passenger may bring one carry-on bag. Checked baggage allowances are shown on each flight result.

/help.question: When do I pay?
/help.answer: Tour bookings can be paid once our team confirms them; hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings can be paid straight after booking. Open My bookings and choose Pay in full, or Pay a deposit to pay part now and the rest later.

/help.question: Which currency are prices in?
/help.answer: All prices are in New Taiwan dollars (TWD) and include tax unless stated otherwise.

/help.question: Can I pay a deposit and the rest later?
/help.answer: Yes. When your trip is more than 14 days away you can pay a 30% deposit now and the balance later. The balance due date is shown in My bookings, and you can pay it there at any time before then. Closer to the travel date, the full amount is due.

/help.question: Which payment methods can I use?
/help.answer: Payments go through our secure payment provider, where you can pay by credit card and, where offered, ATM transfer or convenience-store payment. We never see or store your card number.

/help.question: I paid but my booking still shows unpaid. What should I do?
/help.answer: Some methods, such as ATM transfers, take a little time to confirm. Refresh My bookings after a few minutes. If it still shows unpaid after one working day, contact us with your booking reference and we will check with the payment provider.

/public/content.subject: Cookie policy
/public/content.body:
We use only the cookies needed to keep you signed in safely. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies, so there is nothing to opt out of.
- Two essential cookies, both set by us.
- No advertising, analytics or social media trackers.
- Deleting cookies simply signs you out.

## What cookies are
Cookies are small text files a website stores in your browser. They let the site remember things between pages, such as that you are signed in.

## Cookies we use
### Sign-in cookie
- Purpose: keeps you signed in by renewing your session securely.
- Type: essential, set by {brand}.
- Protection: HttpOnly (scripts cannot read it), Secure (sent only over HTTPS) and SameSite=Strict (never sent by other websites).
- Lifetime: until you sign out, or about two weeks of inactivity.
### Request-protection cookie
- Purpose: proves that requests to change your account really come from this site, which stops other websites from acting on your behalf.
- Type: essential, set by {brand}.
- Lifetime: the same as your sign-in.

## Other storage
Your browser may keep small, harmless preferences on your device, such as a filter you chose. They never leave your device and contain no personal data.

## Third parties
When you pay, you are taken to our payment provider's secure page. That page is run by the provider and follows its own cookie policy.

## Managing cookies
You can delete cookies in your browser settings at any time. Because ours are essential, blocking them means you cannot stay signed in.

## Contact
Questions about cookies: {support}.

/public/content.subject: Privacy notice
/public/content.body:
This notice explains what personal data {brand} collects, why, who we share it with, how long we keep it and the rights you have under Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).
- We only collect what we need to run your bookings and your account.
- Phone and passport numbers are encrypted, and staff see them masked.
- We never sell your data or use advertising trackers.
- You can see, correct, export or delete your data at any time.

## Who we are
{brand} is the data controller for the personal data described here. You can reach our privacy team at {support}. We answer privacy requests within 15 working days, as the PDPA requires.

## What we collect
### Account details
- Your name, email address and password. Passwords are stored only as a salted hash; nobody, including our staff, can read them.
- Your preferred language and when you last signed in.
### Booking details
- The lead traveler's name, mobile phone number and, where a tour requires it, passport or ID number.
- Travel dates, the tours, rooms, seats or rides you book, and any special requests you write.
### Payment details
- The amount, method and status of each payment. Card numbers are entered on our payment provider's secure page and never reach our systems.
### Technical data
- Security logs of sign-ins and important account changes, kept to protect your account and to investigate misuse.

## Why we use it
- To create and manage your account (performance of a contract).
- To make, change and support your bookings with our hotels, transport and guide partners (performance of a contract).
- To take payments and handle refunds (performance of a contract and legal obligation).
- To keep the service secure and prevent fraud (legitimate interest).
- To send our newsletter, only if you subscribe; every email has an unsubscribe link (consent).

## Who we share it with
We share only what each partner needs to deliver your service:
- Hotels, airlines, bus and taxi companies and local guides: the lead traveler's name, dates and number of travelers.
- Our payment provider (ECPay, Taiwan): the payment amount and order reference, to process your payment securely.
- Authorities, only when Taiwanese law requires it.
We do not sell personal data, and we do not share it for advertising.

## How long we keep it
- Traveler details on a booking (names, phone, passport, special requests): anonymised two years after the travel date.
- Messages from our travel partners' systems: deleted after 180 days.
- Security and audit records: kept for seven years to meet accounting and legal duties.
- Your account: until you ask us to delete it.

## How we protect it
- Phone and passport numbers are encrypted with AES-GCM and shown masked to staff; revealing them is permission-controlled and logged.
- All traffic uses HTTPS. Sign-in sessions use secure, HttpOnly cookies and short-lived access tokens.
- Staff can only see what their role allows, and every sensitive action is recorded in an audit log that cannot be edited.

## Your rights
Under the PDPA you can ask us to:
- Show you the personal data we hold about you.
- Give you a copy of it (use Download my data in My account).
- Add to or correct it.
- Stop collecting, processing or using it.
- Delete it.
Write to {support} from the email on your account. We reply within 15 working days. Some data may have to be kept longer where the law requires it; we will tell you if so.

## Children
Our services are for adults. A child's details may be included in a booking only by their parent or guardian.

## Changes to this notice
If we change how we use personal data, we will update this page and the date above, and tell account holders by email about important changes.

## Contact
Questions or concerns: {support}. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you may contact the competent authority in Taiwan.

/public/content.subject: Terms of use
/public/content.body:
These terms apply when you use the {brand} website and book with us. Please read them before you book.
- Tours are confirmed after our team reviews them; hotels, flights, buses and taxis are confirmed instantly.
- You can pay in full, or pay a deposit and the balance later.
- Free cancellation rules are shown on each option before you book.
- Prices are in New Taiwan dollars (TWD) and include tax.

## About these terms
By creating an account or making a booking you agree to these terms and to our privacy notice. If you book for other travelers, you confirm they agree too.

## Your account
- Give accurate details and keep your password private. You are responsible for bookings made with your account.
- We may suspend accounts used for fraud, abuse of coupons or attempts to break the service.

## Bookings
### Tours
- Your seats are held for a short time while you complete the booking. A tour booking is confirmed only when our team approves it; you will see the status change in My bookings.
### Hotels, flights, buses and taxis
- These bookings are confirmed instantly because the room, seat or car is reserved for you at that moment.
- Taxi transfers are booked for the pickup time and address you give; drivers wait for the free waiting time shown on the booking.

## Prices and payment
- Prices are shown in New Taiwan dollars (TWD) and include tax unless stated otherwise.
- You may pay in full, or where offered pay a deposit now and the balance by the due date shown in My bookings. If the balance is not paid in time we may cancel the booking under the cancellation rules.
- Payments are processed securely by our payment provider. We never see or store your card number.

## Coupon codes
- Each code has its own dates, minimum order, booking types and usage limits, shown when you apply it.
- One code per booking. Codes cannot be exchanged for cash. If a booking is cancelled or rejected, the code can be used again within its limits.

## Changes and cancellations
- Cancel from My bookings. Hotels, flights, buses and taxis can usually be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the start; the exact rule is shown on each option.
- Tour cancellations are reviewed by our team, and refunds follow the rules shown when you booked.
- Approved refunds go back to the original payment method; banks usually show them within 5 to 10 working days.

## When we change or cancel
If weather, safety or a partner problem affects your trip, we will contact you with options: another date, a changed plan or a full refund of the affected part.

## Travel documents and conduct
- Bring valid photo ID and any permits your trip needs. Follow the instructions of guides, drivers and staff for everyone's safety.

## Liability
We plan and deliver your services with reasonable care. We are not responsible for losses caused by events outside our reasonable control, such as typhoons, earthquakes or government action. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under Taiwan's Consumer Protection Act.

## Governing law
These terms are governed by the laws of Taiwan (Republic of China).

## Contact
Questions about these terms: {support}.

/help.question: How is my personal data protected?
/help.answer: Phone and passport numbers are encrypted and only shown masked to staff who need them. We keep data only as long as the retention rules in our privacy notice allow.

/help.question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
/help.answer: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your email. If an account exists, we send a link to set a new password.

/help.question: How do I download a copy of my data?
/help.answer: Sign in, open My account and choose Download my data. You get a file with the personal data we hold about your account. To correct or delete data, contact us; see the privacy notice for your rights.

/help.question: How do I book a tour?
/help.answer: Open a tour, choose a date under Dates & prices and press Book. Your seats are held for 15 minutes while you enter traveler details. Our team reviews the booking and confirms it, usually within one working day.

/help.question: Why is my tour booking "Pending"?
/help.answer: Every tour booking is checked by our operations team before it is confirmed, so we can make sure hotels, coaches and guides are ready. You will see the status change to Confirmed in My bookings.

/help.question: Are hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings confirmed straight away?
/help.answer: Yes. These bookings are confirmed instantly when you complete them, because the room or seat is reserved for you at that moment.

/help.question: How do I cancel a booking?
/help.answer: Go to My bookings, open the booking and choose Cancel. Hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the start date. Tour cancellations are reviewed by our team.

/help.question: How long do refunds take?
/help.answer: Approved refunds are sent back to the original payment method. Banks usually show them within 5 to 10 working days.

/help.question: What happens if a typhoon affects my trip?
/help.answer: If weather or transport problems affect a departure, our team contacts you with options: a new date, a changed itinerary or a refund.

/help.question: Is my deposit refunded if I cancel?
/help.answer: Hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings cancelled at least 24 hours before the start are refunded in full, deposit included. Tour cancellations follow the rules shown when you booked and are reviewed by our team.

/help.question: How do I use a coupon code?
/help.answer: Enter the code in the Coupon field when you book. The discount is checked and shown before you confirm. Each code has its own dates, minimum amount and usage limit.

/help.question: Why was my coupon not accepted?
/help.answer: A code may have expired, may not apply to that type of booking, may need a higher order total, or may already have been used the maximum number of times.

/help.question: Do I need to type the coupon code at checkout?
/help.answer: Not if you chose it on the Deals page. Press Use now and we remember the code; it is filled in and applied at checkout automatically when it fits what you are booking. You can still type or change a code yourself.

/help.question: Can I choose my taxi pickup time?
/help.answer: Yes. Airport and city transfers are booked for the time and address you enter. Your driver waits up to 60 minutes after a flight lands.

/help.question: How much luggage can I bring on domestic flights?
/help.answer: Each passenger may bring one carry-on bag. Checked baggage allowances are shown on each flight result.

/help.question: When do I pay?
/help.answer: Tour bookings can be paid once our team confirms them; hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings can be paid straight after booking. Open My bookings and choose Pay in full, or Pay a deposit to pay part now and the rest later.

/help.question: Which currency are prices in?
/help.answer: All prices are in New Taiwan dollars (TWD) and include tax unless stated otherwise.

/help.question: Can I pay a deposit and the rest later?
/help.answer: Yes. When your trip is more than 14 days away you can pay a 30% deposit now and the balance later. The balance due date is shown in My bookings, and you can pay it there at any time before then. Closer to the travel date, the full amount is due.

/help.question: Which payment methods can I use?
/help.answer: Payments go through our secure payment provider, where you can pay by credit card and, where offered, ATM transfer or convenience-store payment. We never see or store your card number.

/help.question: I paid but my booking still shows unpaid. What should I do?
/help.answer: Some methods, such as ATM transfers, take a little time to confirm. Refresh My bookings after a few minutes. If it still shows unpaid after one working day, contact us with your booking reference and we will check with the payment provider.

/public/content.subject: Cookie policy
/public/content.body:
We use only the cookies needed to keep you signed in safely. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies, so there is nothing to opt out of.
- Two essential cookies, both set by us.
- No advertising, analytics or social media trackers.
- Deleting cookies simply signs you out.

## What cookies are
Cookies are small text files a website stores in your browser. They let the site remember things between pages, such as that you are signed in.

## Cookies we use
### Sign-in cookie
- Purpose: keeps you signed in by renewing your session securely.
- Type: essential, set by {brand}.
- Protection: HttpOnly (scripts cannot read it), Secure (sent only over HTTPS) and SameSite=Strict (never sent by other websites).
- Lifetime: until you sign out, or about two weeks of inactivity.
### Request-protection cookie
- Purpose: proves that requests to change your account really come from this site, which stops other websites from acting on your behalf.
- Type: essential, set by {brand}.
- Lifetime: the same as your sign-in.

## Other storage
Your browser may keep small, harmless preferences on your device, such as a filter you chose. They never leave your device and contain no personal data.

## Third parties
When you pay, you are taken to our payment provider's secure page. That page is run by the provider and follows its own cookie policy.

## Managing cookies
You can delete cookies in your browser settings at any time. Because ours are essential, blocking them means you cannot stay signed in.

## Contact
Questions about cookies: {support}.

/public/content.subject: Privacy notice
/public/content.body:
This notice explains what personal data {brand} collects, why, who we share it with, how long we keep it and the rights you have under Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).
- We only collect what we need to run your bookings and your account.
- Phone and passport numbers are encrypted, and staff see them masked.
- We never sell your data or use advertising trackers.
- You can see, correct, export or delete your data at any time.

## Who we are
{brand} is the data controller for the personal data described here. You can reach our privacy team at {support}. We answer privacy requests within 15 working days, as the PDPA requires.

## What we collect
### Account details
- Your name, email address and password. Passwords are stored only as a salted hash; nobody, including our staff, can read them.
- Your preferred language and when you last signed in.
### Booking details
- The lead traveler's name, mobile phone number and, where a tour requires it, passport or ID number.
- Travel dates, the tours, rooms, seats or rides you book, and any special requests you write.
### Payment details
- The amount, method and status of each payment. Card numbers are entered on our payment provider's secure page and never reach our systems.
### Technical data
- Security logs of sign-ins and important account changes, kept to protect your account and to investigate misuse.

## Why we use it
- To create and manage your account (performance of a contract).
- To make, change and support your bookings with our hotels, transport and guide partners (performance of a contract).
- To take payments and handle refunds (performance of a contract and legal obligation).
- To keep the service secure and prevent fraud (legitimate interest).
- To send our newsletter, only if you subscribe; every email has an unsubscribe link (consent).

## Who we share it with
We share only what each partner needs to deliver your service:
- Hotels, airlines, bus and taxi companies and local guides: the lead traveler's name, dates and number of travelers.
- Our payment provider (ECPay, Taiwan): the payment amount and order reference, to process your payment securely.
- Authorities, only when Taiwanese law requires it.
We do not sell personal data, and we do not share it for advertising.

## How long we keep it
- Traveler details on a booking (names, phone, passport, special requests): anonymised two years after the travel date.
- Messages from our travel partners' systems: deleted after 180 days.
- Security and audit records: kept for seven years to meet accounting and legal duties.
- Your account: until you ask us to delete it.

## How we protect it
- Phone and passport numbers are encrypted with AES-GCM and shown masked to staff; revealing them is permission-controlled and logged.
- All traffic uses HTTPS. Sign-in sessions use secure, HttpOnly cookies and short-lived access tokens.
- Staff can only see what their role allows, and every sensitive action is recorded in an audit log that cannot be edited.

## Your rights
Under the PDPA you can ask us to:
- Show you the personal data we hold about you.
- Give you a copy of it (use Download my data in My account).
- Add to or correct it.
- Stop collecting, processing or using it.
- Delete it.
Write to {support} from the email on your account. We reply within 15 working days. Some data may have to be kept longer where the law requires it; we will tell you if so.

## Children
Our services are for adults. A child's details may be included in a booking only by their parent or guardian.

## Changes to this notice
If we change how we use personal data, we will update this page and the date above, and tell account holders by email about important changes.

## Contact
Questions or concerns: {support}. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you may contact the competent authority in Taiwan.

/public/content.subject: Terms of use
/public/content.body:
These terms apply when you use the {brand} website and book with us. Please read them before you book.
- Tours are confirmed after our team reviews them; hotels, flights, buses and taxis are confirmed instantly.
- You can pay in full, or pay a deposit and the balance later.
- Free cancellation rules are shown on each option before you book.
- Prices are in New Taiwan dollars (TWD) and include tax.

## About these terms
By creating an account or making a booking you agree to these terms and to our privacy notice. If you book for other travelers, you confirm they agree too.

## Your account
- Give accurate details and keep your password private. You are responsible for bookings made with your account.
- We may suspend accounts used for fraud, abuse of coupons or attempts to break the service.

## Bookings
### Tours
- Your seats are held for a short time while you complete the booking. A tour booking is confirmed only when our team approves it; you will see the status change in My bookings.
### Hotels, flights, buses and taxis
- These bookings are confirmed instantly because the room, seat or car is reserved for you at that moment.
- Taxi transfers are booked for the pickup time and address you give; drivers wait for the free waiting time shown on the booking.

## Prices and payment
- Prices are shown in New Taiwan dollars (TWD) and include tax unless stated otherwise.
- You may pay in full, or where offered pay a deposit now and the balance by the due date shown in My bookings. If the balance is not paid in time we may cancel the booking under the cancellation rules.
- Payments are processed securely by our payment provider. We never see or store your card number.

## Coupon codes
- Each code has its own dates, minimum order, booking types and usage limits, shown when you apply it.
- One code per booking. Codes cannot be exchanged for cash. If a booking is cancelled or rejected, the code can be used again within its limits.

## Changes and cancellations
- Cancel from My bookings. Hotels, flights, buses and taxis can usually be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the start; the exact rule is shown on each option.
- Tour cancellations are reviewed by our team, and refunds follow the rules shown when you booked.
- Approved refunds go back to the original payment method; banks usually show them within 5 to 10 working days.

## When we change or cancel
If weather, safety or a partner problem affects your trip, we will contact you with options: another date, a changed plan or a full refund of the affected part.

## Travel documents and conduct
- Bring valid photo ID and any permits your trip needs. Follow the instructions of guides, drivers and staff for everyone's safety.

## Liability
We plan and deliver your services with reasonable care. We are not responsible for losses caused by events outside our reasonable control, such as typhoons, earthquakes or government action. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under Taiwan's Consumer Protection Act.

## Governing law
These terms are governed by the laws of Taiwan (Republic of China).

## Contact
Questions about these terms: {support}.

/help.question: How is my personal data protected?
/help.answer: Phone and passport numbers are encrypted and only shown masked to staff who need them. We keep data only as long as the retention rules in our privacy notice allow.

/help.question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
/help.answer: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your email. If an account exists, we send a link to set a new password.

/help.question: How do I download a copy of my data?
/help.answer: Sign in, open My account and choose Download my data. You get a file with the personal data we hold about your account. To correct or delete data, contact us; see the privacy notice for your rights.

/help.question: How do I book a tour?
/help.answer: Open a tour, choose a date under Dates & prices and press Book. Your seats are held for 15 minutes while you enter traveler details. Our team reviews the booking and confirms it, usually within one working day.

/help.question: Why is my tour booking "Pending"?
/help.answer: Every tour booking is checked by our operations team before it is confirmed, so we can make sure hotels, coaches and guides are ready. You will see the status change to Confirmed in My bookings.

/help.question: Are hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings confirmed straight away?
/help.answer: Yes. These bookings are confirmed instantly when you complete them, because the room or seat is reserved for you at that moment.

/help.question: How do I cancel a booking?
/help.answer: Go to My bookings, open the booking and choose Cancel. Hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the start date. Tour cancellations are reviewed by our team.

/help.question: How long do refunds take?
/help.answer: Approved refunds are sent back to the original payment method. Banks usually show them within 5 to 10 working days.

/help.question: What happens if a typhoon affects my trip?
/help.answer: If weather or transport problems affect a departure, our team contacts you with options: a new date, a changed itinerary or a refund.

/help.question: Is my deposit refunded if I cancel?
/help.answer: Hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings cancelled at least 24 hours before the start are refunded in full, deposit included. Tour cancellations follow the rules shown when you booked and are reviewed by our team.

/help.question: How do I use a coupon code?
/help.answer: Enter the code in the Coupon field when you book. The discount is checked and shown before you confirm. Each code has its own dates, minimum amount and usage limit.

/help.question: Why was my coupon not accepted?
/help.answer: A code may have expired, may not apply to that type of booking, may need a higher order total, or may already have been used the maximum number of times.

/help.question: Do I need to type the coupon code at checkout?
/help.answer: Not if you chose it on the Deals page. Press Use now and we remember the code; it is filled in and applied at checkout automatically when it fits what you are booking. You can still type or change a code yourself.

/help.question: Can I choose my taxi pickup time?
/help.answer: Yes. Airport and city transfers are booked for the time and address you enter. Your driver waits up to 60 minutes after a flight lands.

/help.question: How much luggage can I bring on domestic flights?
/help.answer: Each passenger may bring one carry-on bag. Checked baggage allowances are shown on each flight result.

/help.question: When do I pay?
/help.answer: Tour bookings can be paid once our team confirms them; hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings can be paid straight after booking. Open My bookings and choose Pay in full, or Pay a deposit to pay part now and the rest later.

/help.question: Which currency are prices in?
/help.answer: All prices are in New Taiwan dollars (TWD) and include tax unless stated otherwise.

/help.question: Can I pay a deposit and the rest later?
/help.answer: Yes. When your trip is more than 14 days away you can pay a 30% deposit now and the balance later. The balance due date is shown in My bookings, and you can pay it there at any time before then. Closer to the travel date, the full amount is due.

/help.question: Which payment methods can I use?
/help.answer: Payments go through our secure payment provider, where you can pay by credit card and, where offered, ATM transfer or convenience-store payment. We never see or store your card number.

/help.question: I paid but my booking still shows unpaid. What should I do?
/help.answer: Some methods, such as ATM transfers, take a little time to confirm. Refresh My bookings after a few minutes. If it still shows unpaid after one working day, contact us with your booking reference and we will check with the payment provider.

/ops/articles.title: Sanpu launches AI Travel, an assistant that plans and books in one conversation
/ops/articles.summary: Travelers can now describe a trip in their own words and get live options, comparisons and a booking ready to confirm.
/ops/articles.body:
Sanpu has opened AI Travel, a new way to plan a trip with us. Instead of filling in search forms, travelers type what they have in mind, for example "three relaxed days in Hualien for two", and the assistant looks up live tours, rooms, flights, buses and taxis from our booking system.

## What it does
- Suggests a day-by-day plan built from real departures and transport
- Compares tours side by side, including seats left and next dates
- Prepares a booking at the live price and holds it for 30 minutes
- Shows every booking, payment and balance in one place

## People stay in control
The assistant never pays for anyone. Each booking it prepares waits for the traveler to review it and choose a deposit or full payment. When weather or a supplier changes a trip, our operations team reviews the recovery plan before anything changes.

AI Travel is free to use with a Sanpu account.
/ops/articles.imageAlt: Taipei skyline at dusk

/ops/articles.title: Three slow days in the East Rift Valley
/ops/articles.summary: Rice fields, hot springs and empty country roads: a simple plan for the valley between Hualien and Taitung.
/ops/articles.body:
The East Rift Valley is not a place to rush. It is a long, green corridor between two mountain ranges, made for cycling, long lunches and evenings in hot spring water. Here is how we like to spend three days there.

## Day 1: arrive and settle in
Take the morning train or coach from Taipei and check in to a valley inn. Spend the afternoon walking through the rice fields near your stay, then end the day with a soak in a hot spring.

## Day 2: cycle the paddies
Rent a bicycle and follow the flat farm roads at your own pace. Stop at a tea farm in the hills for a tasting, and keep an eye on the light in late afternoon, when the fields turn gold.

## Day 3: a slow way home
Visit a local market for breakfast, pick up rice or tea to take home, and travel back in the afternoon.

## Good to know
- October to April is the most comfortable time to go
- Bring cash for small shops and markets
- A deposit secures your seats; pay the rest closer to the date
/ops/articles.imageAlt: Green valley and river in eastern Taiwan

/ops/articles.title: What to pack for Taiwan in every season
/ops/articles.summary: From summer rain to cold mountain mornings, a simple packing list that works all year round.
/ops/articles.body:
Taiwan's weather changes a lot between the coast and the mountains, and between seasons. Packing well means being ready for heat, rain and the occasional chilly evening.

## All year
- A light rain jacket or compact umbrella
- Comfortable walking shoes that cope with wet streets
- A small day bag for markets and temple visits

## Summer (June to September)
Light, breathable clothes, sun protection and a refillable water bottle. Afternoon showers are common, so plan indoor stops for the early afternoon.

## Winter (December to February)
Layers for the north, where days can be damp and cool, and a warm jacket for Alishan or other mountain stays, where mornings can be cold.

## Good to know
Hotels usually provide slippers and basic toiletries, and convenience stores are everywhere if you forget something.
/ops/articles.imageAlt: Bright hotel room with a suitcase

/ops/articles.title: Holiday season: more express bus seats between Taipei and Tainan
/ops/articles.summary: We have added extra departures on our busiest intercity route for the year-end holidays.
/ops/articles.body:
Year-end travel in Taiwan is busy, and the Taipei to Tainan corridor is one of the first routes to sell out. To give travelers more choice, Sanpu has added extra express bus departures on weekends and public holidays through the season.

## What changes
- More morning departures, so you reach Tainan in time for lunch
- Reserved seats on every departure, with free changes until 24 hours before
- Coupon codes from the Deals page work on these trips

Seats are released in our booking system as soon as each departure is confirmed with the operator, so the earlier you look, the better the choice of times.
/ops/articles.imageAlt: Intercity coach on a highway

/ops/articles.title: Sun Moon Lake on a sensible budget
/ops/articles.summary: How to enjoy Taiwan's best-known lake without overspending, from where to stay to how to get around.
/ops/articles.body:
Sun Moon Lake is popular for good reason: calm water, forested hills and easy walking paths. It can also be pricey on weekends. A little planning keeps the trip relaxed and affordable.

## Choose the right day
Weekdays are quieter and room prices are usually lower. If you can only travel at the weekend, book early and consider a room facing the hills rather than the lake.

## Getting around
- The lakeside cycle path is one of the best ways to see the shore
- Boats connect the main piers, so you can combine a ride and a walk
- Express buses link the lake with Taichung, so you do not need a car

## Eat like the locals
Small restaurants away from the main pier offer simple, good meals at fair prices. Try local tea, which is grown in the hills around the lake.

Tip: compare our lake tours with a hotel-plus-bus plan on the Compare page to see which suits your trip.
/ops/articles.imageAlt: Sun Moon Lake with mountains behind

/ops/articles.title: Why the cooler months are Taiwan's busiest travel season
/ops/articles.summary: From October to April, clear skies and mild temperatures bring travelers back to the mountains and the east coast.
/ops/articles.body:
Taiwan travel follows the weather. Summer is hot and humid, and from July to September typhoons can close mountain roads and ferry routes. As temperatures drop in autumn, demand moves back to the places that are hardest to enjoy in summer.

## Where travelers go
- **Mountains:** sunrise viewing and forest trails around Alishan are at their best in clear, cool air.
- **East coast:** the Hualien and Taitung valleys are easier to explore by bicycle when the heat eases.
- **Islands:** Kinmen's heritage villages are comfortable to walk for a full day.

## What it means for booking
Popular weekends fill early, especially around public holidays. Booking with a deposit lets you secure seats and rooms now and pay the balance closer to the date.
/ops/articles.imageAlt: Gorge and river near Hualien

/ops/articles.title: A weekend of food in Tainan
/ops/articles.summary: Taiwan's oldest city is also one of its best for eating. A two-day plan for hungry travelers.
/ops/articles.body:
Tainan was the island's capital for more than two centuries, and its streets still mix temples, old shophouses and family-run food stalls. Two days is enough to taste the classics if you pace yourself.

## Saturday: old town and temples
Start early, because many favorite breakfast spots sell out by mid-morning. Spend the morning around the old temples, then try savoury rice cakes and milkfish soup for lunch. In the evening, walk the lanes near the old canal and graze from stall to stall.

## Sunday: markets and sweets
Visit a morning market, try a bowl of shaved ice in the afternoon heat, and pick up local pastries for the trip home.

## Getting there
Express buses and trains connect Taipei and Tainan in a few hours. A heritage guesthouse in the old town puts most of the food within walking distance.
/ops/articles.imageAlt: Historic temple in Tainan

/ops/articles.title: Planning an Alishan sunrise without the stress
/ops/articles.summary: Early starts, cold mornings and limited seats: what to know before you go up the mountain.
/ops/articles.body:
Watching the sun rise over a sea of clouds at Alishan is one of Taiwan's classic experiences. It also means a very early start and a cold wait, so preparation matters.

## Before you go
- Stay at least one night on the mountain; the first shuttle leaves well before dawn
- Pack warm layers, even in spring and autumn
- Check the weather the evening before; clouds below the viewpoint are good news

## On the morning
Arrive at the viewpoint early to find a good spot, bring a hot drink, and be patient. After sunrise, the forest trails are quiet and beautiful in the soft light.

## Make it easy
Our Alishan tour includes the mountain stay and the early transfer, so you only need to set an alarm.
/ops/articles.imageAlt: Forest and mountain ridges at Alishan

/ops/articles.title: Smaller groups for our Kinmen heritage tours
/ops/articles.summary: Our Kinmen departures now run with fewer travelers per guide, for quieter visits to the old villages.
/ops/articles.body:
Kinmen's villages are small, with narrow lanes and family homes that are still lived in. To keep visits respectful and relaxed, Sanpu has reduced the size of its Kinmen heritage groups.

Each departure now travels with fewer guests per guide, which means more time at each stop, easier conversations with the guide, and less crowding at the courtyard houses.

## Also new
- Bicycle time in the afternoon for those who want to explore on their own
- A slower schedule on the second day, with an early finish before the flight home

You can see dates, prices and seats left on the tour page and in the departure calendar.
/ops/articles.imageAlt: Traditional houses in a Kinmen village

/ops/articles.title: Behind the scenes: how we plan a new tour
/ops/articles.summary: From the first scouting trip to the first departure, here is how a Sanpu tour comes together.
/ops/articles.body:
Every Sanpu tour starts with a simple question: would we enjoy this trip ourselves? From there, a small team spends months turning an idea into a departure you can book.

## Scouting
Our planners travel the route in different seasons, test the timing between stops, and look for places where travelers can slow down rather than rush.

## Partners
We work with family-run inns, local guides and transport partners we know well. Each one agrees to our standards for comfort, safety and fair treatment of staff.

## Testing
Before a tour opens, colleagues travel it as guests and report what felt too long, too short or simply wonderful. The schedule changes based on what they say.

## After launch
Feedback from every departure goes back to the team, and small changes keep each tour fresh from season to season.
/ops/articles.imageAlt: Forest trail in the mountains

/ops/articles.title: Late-night arrivals: airport transfers now run around the clock
/ops/articles.summary: Travelers landing after midnight can now book a fixed-price transfer into the city, with a driver waiting at arrivals.
/ops/articles.body:
Many flights into Taiwan land late in the evening, when public transport is winding down. To make the last part of the journey easy, Sanpu airport transfers can now be booked for any time of day or night.

## How it works
- Choose your pickup time when you book; the price is fixed in advance
- Your driver tracks the flight and waits at arrivals if you are delayed
- Child seats and accessible vans can be added on the booking page

## Paying
Transfers can be paid in full when you book, or added to a tour or hotel booking you already have. You will find every booking, payment and receipt under My bookings.
/ops/articles.imageAlt: Taxi waiting on a city street at night

/ops/articles.title: How travelers are choosing between rail, coach and short flights
/ops/articles.summary: Shorter trips and flexible plans are changing how people move around Taiwan. A look at what matters most when choosing transport.
/ops/articles.body:
Getting around Taiwan has never been easier, and travelers now mix transport more freely than before. A typical week might combine a high-speed train, an express coach and a short island flight.

## What travelers weigh up
- **Time door to door:** a flight is quick in the air, but airport time matters on short routes
- **Comfort and luggage:** coaches with reserved seats suit groups and families with bags
- **Flexibility:** free changes until shortly before departure are now an important part of the choice

## Planning tips
Island flights to Kinmen and the east coast fill early on holiday weekends, so book those first and fit the rest of the trip around them. Coaches are a good backup when weather affects flights.

/ops/help/articles.question: How is my personal data protected?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Phone and passport numbers are encrypted and only shown masked to staff who need them. We keep data only as long as the retention rules in our privacy notice allow.

/ops/help/articles.question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your email. If an account exists, we send a link to set a new password.

/ops/help/articles.question: How do I download a copy of my data?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Sign in, open My account and choose Download my data. You get a file with the personal data we hold about your account. To correct or delete data, contact us; see the privacy notice for your rights.

/ops/help/articles.question: How do I book a tour?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Open a tour, choose a date under Dates & prices and press Book. Your seats are held for 15 minutes while you enter traveler details. Our team reviews the booking and confirms it, usually within one working day.

/ops/help/articles.question: Why is my tour booking "Pending"?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Every tour booking is checked by our operations team before it is confirmed, so we can make sure hotels, coaches and guides are ready. You will see the status change to Confirmed in My bookings.

/ops/help/articles.question: Are hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings confirmed straight away?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Yes. These bookings are confirmed instantly when you complete them, because the room or seat is reserved for you at that moment.

/ops/help/articles.question: How do I cancel a booking?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Go to My bookings, open the booking and choose Cancel. Hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the start date. Tour cancellations are reviewed by our team.

/ops/help/articles.question: How long do refunds take?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Approved refunds are sent back to the original payment method. Banks usually show them within 5 to 10 working days.

/ops/help/articles.question: What happens if a typhoon affects my trip?
/ops/help/articles.answer: If weather or transport problems affect a departure, our team contacts you with options: a new date, a changed itinerary or a refund.

/ops/help/articles.question: Is my deposit refunded if I cancel?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings cancelled at least 24 hours before the start are refunded in full, deposit included. Tour cancellations follow the rules shown when you booked and are reviewed by our team.

/ops/help/articles.question: How do I use a coupon code?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Enter the code in the Coupon field when you book. The discount is checked and shown before you confirm. Each code has its own dates, minimum amount and usage limit.

/ops/help/articles.question: Why was my coupon not accepted?
/ops/help/articles.answer: A code may have expired, may not apply to that type of booking, may need a higher order total, or may already have been used the maximum number of times.

/ops/help/articles.question: Do I need to type the coupon code at checkout?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Not if you chose it on the Deals page. Press Use now and we remember the code; it is filled in and applied at checkout automatically when it fits what you are booking. You can still type or change a code yourself.

/ops/help/articles.question: Can I choose my taxi pickup time?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Yes. Airport and city transfers are booked for the time and address you enter. Your driver waits up to 60 minutes after a flight lands.

/ops/help/articles.question: How much luggage can I bring on domestic flights?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Each passenger may bring one carry-on bag. Checked baggage allowances are shown on each flight result.

/ops/help/articles.question: When do I pay?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Tour bookings can be paid once our team confirms them; hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings can be paid straight after booking. Open My bookings and choose Pay in full, or Pay a deposit to pay part now and the rest later.

/ops/help/articles.question: Which currency are prices in?
/ops/help/articles.answer: All prices are in New Taiwan dollars (TWD) and include tax unless stated otherwise.

/ops/help/articles.question: Can I pay a deposit and the rest later?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Yes. When your trip is more than 14 days away you can pay a 30% deposit now and the balance later. The balance due date is shown in My bookings, and you can pay it there at any time before then. Closer to the travel date, the full amount is due.

/ops/help/articles.question: Which payment methods can I use?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Payments go through our secure payment provider, where you can pay by credit card and, where offered, ATM transfer or convenience-store payment. We never see or store your card number.

/ops/help/articles.question: I paid but my booking still shows unpaid. What should I do?
/ops/help/articles.answer: Some methods, such as ATM transfers, take a little time to confirm. Refresh My bookings after a few minutes. If it still shows unpaid after one working day, contact us with your booking reference and we will check with the payment provider.

/public/content.subject: Cookie policy
/public/content.body:
We use only the cookies needed to keep you signed in safely. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies, so there is nothing to opt out of.
- Two essential cookies, both set by us.
- No advertising, analytics or social media trackers.
- Deleting cookies simply signs you out.

## What cookies are
Cookies are small text files a website stores in your browser. They let the site remember things between pages, such as that you are signed in.

## Cookies we use
### Sign-in cookie
- Purpose: keeps you signed in by renewing your session securely.
- Type: essential, set by {brand}.
- Protection: HttpOnly (scripts cannot read it), Secure (sent only over HTTPS) and SameSite=Strict (never sent by other websites).
- Lifetime: until you sign out, or about two weeks of inactivity.
### Request-protection cookie
- Purpose: proves that requests to change your account really come from this site, which stops other websites from acting on your behalf.
- Type: essential, set by {brand}.
- Lifetime: the same as your sign-in.

## Other storage
Your browser may keep small, harmless preferences on your device, such as a filter you chose. They never leave your device and contain no personal data.

## Third parties
When you pay, you are taken to our payment provider's secure page. That page is run by the provider and follows its own cookie policy.

## Managing cookies
You can delete cookies in your browser settings at any time. Because ours are essential, blocking them means you cannot stay signed in.

## Contact
Questions about cookies: {support}.

/public/content.subject: Privacy notice
/public/content.body:
This notice explains what personal data {brand} collects, why, who we share it with, how long we keep it and the rights you have under Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).
- We only collect what we need to run your bookings and your account.
- Phone and passport numbers are encrypted, and staff see them masked.
- We never sell your data or use advertising trackers.
- You can see, correct, export or delete your data at any time.

## Who we are
{brand} is the data controller for the personal data described here. You can reach our privacy team at {support}. We answer privacy requests within 15 working days, as the PDPA requires.

## What we collect
### Account details
- Your name, email address and password. Passwords are stored only as a salted hash; nobody, including our staff, can read them.
- Your preferred language and when you last signed in.
### Booking details
- The lead traveler's name, mobile phone number and, where a tour requires it, passport or ID number.
- Travel dates, the tours, rooms, seats or rides you book, and any special requests you write.
### Payment details
- The amount, method and status of each payment. Card numbers are entered on our payment provider's secure page and never reach our systems.
### Technical data
- Security logs of sign-ins and important account changes, kept to protect your account and to investigate misuse.

## Why we use it
- To create and manage your account (performance of a contract).
- To make, change and support your bookings with our hotels, transport and guide partners (performance of a contract).
- To take payments and handle refunds (performance of a contract and legal obligation).
- To keep the service secure and prevent fraud (legitimate interest).
- To send our newsletter, only if you subscribe; every email has an unsubscribe link (consent).

## Who we share it with
We share only what each partner needs to deliver your service:
- Hotels, airlines, bus and taxi companies and local guides: the lead traveler's name, dates and number of travelers.
- Our payment provider (ECPay, Taiwan): the payment amount and order reference, to process your payment securely.
- Authorities, only when Taiwanese law requires it.
We do not sell personal data, and we do not share it for advertising.

## How long we keep it
- Traveler details on a booking (names, phone, passport, special requests): anonymised two years after the travel date.
- Messages from our travel partners' systems: deleted after 180 days.
- Security and audit records: kept for seven years to meet accounting and legal duties.
- Your account: until you ask us to delete it.

## How we protect it
- Phone and passport numbers are encrypted with AES-GCM and shown masked to staff; revealing them is permission-controlled and logged.
- All traffic uses HTTPS. Sign-in sessions use secure, HttpOnly cookies and short-lived access tokens.
- Staff can only see what their role allows, and every sensitive action is recorded in an audit log that cannot be edited.

## Your rights
Under the PDPA you can ask us to:
- Show you the personal data we hold about you.
- Give you a copy of it (use Download my data in My account).
- Add to or correct it.
- Stop collecting, processing or using it.
- Delete it.
Write to {support} from the email on your account. We reply within 15 working days. Some data may have to be kept longer where the law requires it; we will tell you if so.

## Children
Our services are for adults. A child's details may be included in a booking only by their parent or guardian.

## Changes to this notice
If we change how we use personal data, we will update this page and the date above, and tell account holders by email about important changes.

## Contact
Questions or concerns: {support}. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you may contact the competent authority in Taiwan.

/public/content.subject: Terms of use
/public/content.body:
These terms apply when you use the {brand} website and book with us. Please read them before you book.
- Tours are confirmed after our team reviews them; hotels, flights, buses and taxis are confirmed instantly.
- You can pay in full, or pay a deposit and the balance later.
- Free cancellation rules are shown on each option before you book.
- Prices are in New Taiwan dollars (TWD) and include tax.

## About these terms
By creating an account or making a booking you agree to these terms and to our privacy notice. If you book for other travelers, you confirm they agree too.

## Your account
- Give accurate details and keep your password private. You are responsible for bookings made with your account.
- We may suspend accounts used for fraud, abuse of coupons or attempts to break the service.

## Bookings
### Tours
- Your seats are held for a short time while you complete the booking. A tour booking is confirmed only when our team approves it; you will see the status change in My bookings.
### Hotels, flights, buses and taxis
- These bookings are confirmed instantly because the room, seat or car is reserved for you at that moment.
- Taxi transfers are booked for the pickup time and address you give; drivers wait for the free waiting time shown on the booking.

## Prices and payment
- Prices are shown in New Taiwan dollars (TWD) and include tax unless stated otherwise.
- You may pay in full, or where offered pay a deposit now and the balance by the due date shown in My bookings. If the balance is not paid in time we may cancel the booking under the cancellation rules.
- Payments are processed securely by our payment provider. We never see or store your card number.

## Coupon codes
- Each code has its own dates, minimum order, booking types and usage limits, shown when you apply it.
- One code per booking. Codes cannot be exchanged for cash. If a booking is cancelled or rejected, the code can be used again within its limits.

## Changes and cancellations
- Cancel from My bookings. Hotels, flights, buses and taxis can usually be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the start; the exact rule is shown on each option.
- Tour cancellations are reviewed by our team, and refunds follow the rules shown when you booked.
- Approved refunds go back to the original payment method; banks usually show them within 5 to 10 working days.

## When we change or cancel
If weather, safety or a partner problem affects your trip, we will contact you with options: another date, a changed plan or a full refund of the affected part.

## Travel documents and conduct
- Bring valid photo ID and any permits your trip needs. Follow the instructions of guides, drivers and staff for everyone's safety.

## Liability
We plan and deliver your services with reasonable care. We are not responsible for losses caused by events outside our reasonable control, such as typhoons, earthquakes or government action. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under Taiwan's Consumer Protection Act.

## Governing law
These terms are governed by the laws of Taiwan (Republic of China).

## Contact
Questions about these terms: {support}.

/help.answer: Tour bookings can be paid once our team confirms them; hotel, flight, bus and taxi bookings can be paid straight after booking. Open My bookings and choose Pay in full, or Pay a deposit to pay part now and the rest later.

/help.question: Which currency are prices in?
/help.answer: All prices are in New Taiwan dollars (TWD) and include tax unless stated otherwise.

/help.question: Can I pay a deposit and the rest later?
/help.answer: Yes. When your trip is more than 14 days away you can pay a 30% deposit now and the balance later. The balance due date is shown in My bookings, and you can pay it there at any time before then. Closer to the travel date, the full amount is due.

/help.question: Which payment methods can I use?
/help.answer: Payments go through our secure payment provider, where you can pay by credit card and, where offered, ATM transfer or convenience-store payment. We never see or store your card number.

/help.question: I paid but my booking still shows unpaid. What should I do?
/help.answer: Some methods, such as ATM transfers, take a little time to confirm. Refresh My bookings after a few minutes. If it still shows unpaid after one working day, contact us with your booking reference and we will check with the payment provider.

/public/content.subject: Cookie policy
/public/content.body:
We use only the cookies needed to keep you signed in safely. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies, so there is nothing to opt out of.
- Two essential cookies, both set by us.
- No advertising, analytics or social media trackers.
- Deleting cookies simply signs you out.

## What cookies are
Cookies are small text files a website stores in your browser. They let the site remember things between pages, such as that you are signed in.

## Cookies we use
### Sign-in cookie
- Purpose: keeps you signed in by renewing your session securely.
- Type: essential, set by {brand}.
- Protection: HttpOnly (scripts cannot read it), Secure (sent only over HTTPS) and SameSite=Strict (never sent by other websites).
- Lifetime: until you sign out, or about two weeks of inactivity.
### Request-protection cookie
- Purpose: proves that requests to change your account really come from this site, which stops other websites from acting on your behalf.
- Type: essential, set by {brand}.
- Lifetime: the same as your sign-in.

## Other storage
Your browser may keep small, harmless preferences on your device, such as a filter you chose. They never leave your device and contain no personal data.

## Third parties
When you pay, you are taken to our payment provider's secure page. That page is run by the provider and follows its own cookie policy.

## Managing cookies
You can delete cookies in your browser settings at any time. Because ours are essential, blocking them means you cannot stay signed in.

## Contact
Questions about cookies: {support}.
